body: @zlepper which exact version of Angular was this working on in the past? I will do a bisect analysis.

@matsko I shortened @zlepper 's Stackblitz and added some notes to it. Hopefully that helps with debugging.

https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-animation-issue-3uj6gg

Angular Dependencies are now at v9.1.4

The issue seems to be that after reordering, the animation callbacks are not registered correctly on the child elements of *ngFor-copied elements.

@mark-langer just applying a `trackBy` function solves the issue 🙂 

[original stackblitz + trackBy](https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-animation-issue-tucgbb?file=src%2Fapp%2Fapp.component.ts)

The [docs](https://angular.io/api/core/TrackByFunction#description) do specify that the `trackBy` is necessary for animations to work correctly on list items 

(related issue: https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/42750)

issue.title: docs(animations): add section about animating reordering list items

issue.body:
add a section regarding reordering list items in the complex animation
sequences guide to help developers rememeber to use a `TrackByFunction`
whenever they are animating `*ngFor` list items which change their
ordering

as suggested here: https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/42750#issuecomment-979127165

relates to issue #28040 and #42750
